svg.text: The kind line (2) and the lamp (4) gone, the screen grown up (9), the type and the state on its first line (5), the hide key into the keys' row (3), PipeWire's nodes and ports on line 3 (10). A sound card's face, 3.6 times its size.
· As before (left as it is), where it was
· The lamp and the hide key gone from its line: room 190 (was 160):
SCREEN · LINE 1 · THE TYPE AND THE STATE
· The device's type, one word or two, nothing after it: what it is, not
· Hardware: SOUND CARD, HDMI AUDIO, HEADSET, HEADPHONES, SPEAKER,
· Made in software: VIRTUAL SINK, VIRTUAL SOURCE, FILTER, LOOPBACK,
· The state against the right edge: RUNNING, IDLE, SUSPENDED, ERROR
(PipeWire's node state; a device of several nodes: the busiest)
· The longest fits: VIRTUAL SOURCE … SUSPENDED is 23 of 27 characters
· From the Device (device.form-factor, else SOUND CARD; HDMI from the
profile); with none, from the nodes (media.class, factory.name,
· The links only: 2 LINKS, NO LINKS (the state moved up to line 1)
· For a moment after a change: VOLUME 80 %, BAL L20, the new profile,
SCREEN · LINE 3 · what it takes of PipeWire
· On every device: how many PipeWire nodes and ports are behind its face
· A card: 2 NODES 6 PORTS (a sink with its monitor, a source)
· An app of one stream: 1 NODE 2 PORTS; Easy Effects under one roof: 7
· A card: its profile · codec (· UNPLUGGED), scrolling when long
· Anything else: MIDI, STEREO or MONO
HIDE key · moved into the keys' row
· An eye struck through: takes the device off the desk and the rack
· Always there, on every face, always at the left of the row; the same
· From y 43 (was 54): 57 high (was 46 on a card, 57 elsewhere)
· The same on every face: every face has the keys' row now
· Four lines (were three); still 187 wide, 27 characters
· Narrower, say 150 (21 characters): about 40 more for frames on every
· PROFILE on every card with profiles; PORT beside it when an output or
input has more than one port
· They share what the hide key leaves of the row evenly: 78 each, or one
· A face without them (an app, a virtual device): the hide key alone
· No keys: a click on line 3 opens the profiles; the screen full height
· Green, amber or dark beside the hide key: the same as the state word
· The state is on the screen's line 1 now (5)
· ALSA · PCI, APP · PLAYBACK… were here, between the name and the screen
· The screen took the room; the type moved onto it (5)
· The model stays in the app: the status bar on hover, the HIDDEN list
The name is only on the plate; the screen starts with the type and the state.
